biggest_gap.what: All 43 martial texts carry the same three orthographic and page-furniture fingerprints, every one of them in a place tools/check-prose.mjs does not read. Bare Arabic numerals run 128.5 per 10k words against Morrowind's measured 9.3 (13.8x) and against the rest of this project's own library at 24.9; 65.1% of the texts carry two or more ALL-CAPS section headings against Morrowind's 2.1% (31x) and this library's 8.4%; and 60 of the 188 headings carry a ', WHICH ...' appositive against 1 in Morrowind's whole 241-book corpus. Two of the three are gate artifacts: check-prose RULE-06 penalises SPELLED counts four..twenty, so de-spelling turns the row green (the status file banks it as a win, 90.77 -> 52.42), and RULE-17/RULE-28's ', which is' tic did not go away in round 4 — it moved one line up into the headings, where a sentence-level detector cannot see it.
biggest_gap.why_it_matters: A player who reads three of these books in three different towns is meant to meet three people and instead meets one writer in three costumes — and the seam shows inside single sentences, as in 'Every file is to carry 2 bills and they are to be given to the two largest men in it' and 'Water bottle, 2 — two, not one'.

remedy.action: Three mechanical edits, none of which rewrites an argument, an image or a joke. (1) Re-spell numerals in narrative prose across the 43 texts, keeping Arabic figures ONLY where a document would really carry them — the muster leaf, the rack tally, the day-book, the handbill's stoppages, registry numbers and 3E dates. This will re-redden check-prose RULE-06, and that is the correct outcome: the rule's own reference is Morrowind and Morrowind spells them, so re-baseline RULE-06 against tools/uesp/mw-book-stats.py's measured distribution (one 68.0% decaying smoothly to thirteen 2.9%, no bump) instead of a flat penalty. (2) Break the heading template: take texts carrying two or more ALL-CAPS headings from 65% to at most 20%, delete the ', WHICH ...' appositive from at least 45 of the 60 headings, and leave at most 12 headings beginning with WHAT — several of these texts should carry no headings at all, since a hunter's oral teaching, a nephew's account of two uncles arguing and a letter found folded in a helmet do not come with a table of contents. (3) Convert Imperial-year counts to sap-falls in at least 8 of the 15 Argonian-authored texts and let at least one refuse to convert, the way game/data/books/quest-keys.json already does. Separately, extend tools/check-prose.mjs to read headings: it reads sentences only, which is why 60 instances of a tracked tic survived a round whose entire subject was tics.
remedy.acceptance: node tools/lore/critic-martial-r4-fingerprint.mjs --mw=<dump> exits 0 — that is, bare numerals in the martial set at most 3x the Morrowind reference of 9.3 per 10k, and texts carrying two or more ALL-CAPS headings at most 3x the reference 2.1% — with sap-fall occurrences in the martial set >= 8, and tools/check-prose.mjs still clean on all seven files except a deliberately re-baselined RULE-06 whose new bar is quoted from mw-book-stats.py output.
remedy.estimated_size: one agent-round; it is a find-and-replace pass with judgement, not a rewrite

secondary_observations.what: AN UNDECLARED CROSS-FILE COLLISION THAT IS WORTH MORE DECLARED THAN SWEPT. Four martial author names are also four of the seven names in game/data/books/the-books-in-evidence.json:the-cutters-list, a keepers' register of people who opened a Hist well untaught, each entry ending in a death. Ganeeth-Ei writes volume III of his memoir at 61 at his sister's house at Hollow-Reeds and the register has him 'Killed at the Bone Ladder in the same season'. Weeth-Ei-Vakh teaches the claw at Helstrom and 'Walked into the marsh in the wet season and was not looked for'. Ojal-Aneesh and Teeus-Ahai likewise. No contradicts edge, no canon-fact, no note in either file, and I could not establish which was written first — both landed 2026-08-07 and the authored history is under bank commits. Under RI-LOR06 and Morrowind's own convention this is a GIFT and not a bug: a player who reads the memoir and then the register learns the man who printed three volumes about thirty years in the Ninth was killed opening a well, and the game never says which is true. That is the most Morrowind thing in the whole martial expansion and it happened by accident. The danger is exactly that — undeclared, the next agent to run a name-uniqueness sweep will 'fix' it. Declare it in both files, do not resolve it.

A LIVE NEIGHBOUR'S PROBE CANNOT RUN, AND ITS VERDICT MAY BE ABOUT TO CITE IT. tools/lore/critic-w1-23-r5-consume.mjs scans its own non-comment bytes for the prohibited harness verbs 'openMenu' and '__ENGINE' — and the loop that LISTS those two strings is itself a non-comment line, so body.includes("'openMenu'") always matches the guard. Verified on HEAD: exit 2, zero legs, every time. A guard that can only ever fire on itself. I did not touch their file (rule 16); my own copy assembles the names from fragments and runs. That piece's author should know before its verdict quotes numbers this file as it stands cannot produce.

A SHARED IMAGE THAT TWO UNRELATED AUTHORS COULD NOT HAVE SHARED. Beem-Ei, an Argonian who keeps the armoury at Helstrom, and Ivas, a Dunmer serjo's smith at Blackrose, independently invent the same original metaphor for the guard-angle rule in the same anatomy — 'Every shield covers a wedge, with the point of the wedge at your shoulder' and 'A shield covers a wedge with the point at the shoulder'. The word 'wedge' appears 14 times across 4 texts by 4 unrelated authors. game/data/weapons/offhand.json's guard angle is showing through the fiction.

THE ROUND'S OWN ARITHMETIC FINDING ABOUT RI-LOR03 SECTION 2 IS CORRECT AND I CONFIRMED IT RATHER THAN REPEATING IT. The ten taxon minimums sum to 122 (16+10+14+16+10+12+12+10+6+16) against a stated corpus target of 112 texts, so any corpus that hits 112 must be short on some row by arithmetic. The table is internally inconsistent as written. This is the third thing on the list that item's own provenance note asks its next owner to decide deliberately rather than inherit.

THE STATUS FILE LISTS game/data/books/the-articles-of-the-wet-ledger.json as an output and no such file exists. The text is real and lives inside game/data/books/the-long-service.json, is surfaced by game/data/world/interiors/lilmoth-ledger-house.json, and carries the knowledge_key that Q-LEDG-14 and Q-LEDG-15 need. Not a defect — noted so the next agent does not go hunting for a file that was never meant to exist.

gap_closure.note: Independently confirmed: 25 book files, 162 texts, 112,812 words on the tree at 3d4c88d, well past RI-LOR03's 112-text target. The nine skills that scored zero all carry grounded books now.

The seven martial files ARE clean under tools/check-prose.mjs — I ran it and none of the 67 remaining corpus regressions is theirs. But the ', which is' tic the round reports clearing did not leave the corpus; it moved into the ALL-CAPS headings, where the detector does not read, and it is denser there (60 of 188) than it ever was in the prose.

method_deviations.deviation: No blind comparison was run, so RI-LOR03's own headline method (blind pair against real Morrowind books) is not exercised in this verdict.
method_deviations.why: Rule 25 forbids judging a pack I built and rule 0 records that create_session is approval-gated here (MCP error -32003), so there is no second judge to hand a pack to. The piece's own notes_for_successor already names this as the one measurement that would settle whether these are books or filler, and it is still not done. My prose-quality score of 8.4 is therefore a SIGHTED reading and is weaker evidence than a blind pass; I say so rather than let it stand as equivalent. What the round does now have that it did not before is the tell a blind judge would use, measured and published: it is not 'yours all sound informative', it is the numerals and the headings.

method_deviations.deviation: The four-arm consumption probe (tools/lore/critic-martial-r4-consume.mjs) was written and launched under a passing contention gate but did not return inside this critic's window. Its numbers are NOT in this verdict and RI-MTH07 is scored 7.0 on a traced coupling chain rather than 10 on a demonstrated one.
method_deviations.why: Rule 26. A number I did not see is not a number I may report, and rule 5's whole point is that 'the mechanism works, therefore my rows are read' is the inference that has cost sixteen subsystems. The census result (43/43 surfaced, zero orphans, consumer named by path and line) is independent of the probe and stands on its own.

method_deviations.deviation: I ran tools/readables/mk-papers.mjs by accident while probing for a --help flag, on the working tree rather than a copy.
method_deviations.why: It is deterministic; git status --porcelain game/data/ came back empty immediately afterwards and nothing in the tree moved. Reported because a silent accident is not a result.

self_audit.self_audit_note: Two methods short and both are declared in method_deviations rather than buried. (1) No blind pair: rule 25 plus an approval-gated create_session leaves no second judge, so RI-LOR03's headline instrument was not exercised and my prose score is a sighted one. (2) The consumption probe did not return in the window, so RI-MTH07 is scored on a traced chain, not a demonstrated one. Neither absence is scored as clean. Against them: the fingerprint instrument WAS broken on purpose in two directions (fail-closed at exit 2 with no reference; selftest arm collapsing onto the reference when fed reference text), and the finding carries a control arm — the rest of this project's library — which is what makes it a claim about this block rather than about the house style.

notes: The hand-off asked the critic to read the prose and not the gate, and said the green gate was 'exactly the claim a blind reader has to falsify'. It was right to ask. The writing is genuinely excellent — 'A door is a piece of wall that has agreed to walk'; a Legate who is asked what he would cut from his own regulation and answers 'so would I, and I can't'; an Argonian explaining that the province manufactured its own folklore as a security measure and the game never saying whether he is right. Nothing here reads as a codex entry. But the gate that certifies it is counting characters, and two of its rules have been satisfied by moving the offence somewhere the counter does not look: spelled numbers became Arabic figures at 13.8x Morrowind's rate, and the ', which is' tic climbed one line into the section headings, where it is denser than it ever was in the prose. The worst sentence in fifty thousand words — 'Two doors are 2 slow people carrying 2 walls' — is a good sentence paying a tax to a checker. That is the round's finding, and the remedy is a day's mechanical work that does not touch a single argument in the corpus.
